W. E. B. Du Bois, Darkwater.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/w-e-b-du-bois/darkwater

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- W. E. B. Du Bois, the annotator, the author and the writer of the preface, died 1963 (Wikidata Q158060, P570 = 1963-08-27).

First publication of the text used: 1920 (SE colophon: 'Darkwater was published in 1920 by W. E. B. Du Bois.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The text was first published in 1920, before 1931, so it entered the United States public domain 95 years after publication, in 2015.
- Country of origin: United States. The text was first published in New York in 1920 (publisher Harcourt, Brace and Howe; source: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darkwater, infobox: publication date 1920, publication place New York, USA). The United States rule settles the origin, so the death of W. E. B. Du Bois in 1963 does not change the result. The text entered the public domain of its country of origin 95 years after publication, in 2015.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
